relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Erenumab, a human anti-CGRP monoclonal antibody medication, modulates CGRP, which is elevated in patients with TN.

relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Nine of 10 patients (90.0%) reported improvement in pain severity and in global mood improvement.

key_findings: Erenumab improved pain in 9 of 10 refractory trigeminal neuralgia patients with minimal side effects (retrospective, Class IV evidence).
